title: Battle of the Bay of Velez
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Bay of Velez", at revision 1375535408, opens: "The Battle of the Bay of Velez or the Battle of Velez was a naval battle between the forces of Salah Reis and a Portuguese flotilla in which the forces of Salah Reis emerged victorious, captured the Portuguese squadron and seized the Penon de Velez. The Portuguese fleet was commanded by Inácio Nunes Gato, who was also the official interpreter for John III." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q116609273, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1553 naval battle between the forces of Salah Reis and a Portuguese flotilla". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
